regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title/DOI. The abstract reports the experimentally/computationally supported +15° M1/P2/M1'/P2' (P)-1 and +23° P1/P2/P1'/P2' (P)-2 aggregate structures; these statements are linked to the later DFT records rather than counted as new preparations.

regions.region: page 1 Introduction and generic self-assembly discussion
regions.finding: Classified prior supramolecular-polymer/allene literature as context and the proposed coaxial internal/external helix idea as a current generic model. No current-paper reaction arrow, sample charge, spectrum, or yield occurs on this page.

unresolved: The abstract is an aggregate summary and does not supply experiment-specific preparation or operating details.
Cited external experiments were not imported as current-paper records.

regions.finding: Recorded one general structural model for generic chiral allene and possible Pint/Pext or Mint/Mext coaxial helices. The model is not a preparation and receives no experimental yield.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Results and Discussion compound-design/synthesis paragraph
regions.finding: Retained the current-paper statement that (P)/(M)-1 and (P)/(M)-2 were synthesized, but all synthetic details are referred to unassociated SI S3/cited protocols and remain an unresolved record rather than invented reactions.

Recorded separate (P)-1 ECD, (P)-1 UV/Vis, and (P)-2 ECD solvent-comparison experiments with peak positions, concentrations, aggregation observations, and product-state targets. The (P)-1 UV/Vis CHCl3 concentration conflict is retained cross-page with Figure 1.

unresolved: The four allene syntheses cannot be reconstructed without associated SI.
The page-2 prose prints 10 mM for the (P)-1 CHCl3 UV/Vis sample, conflicting with the 10 μM Figure 1 caption.
Spectroscopic sample preparation and instrumental details are incomplete.

regions.finding: Visually inspected the full structures of (P)-1 and (P)-2. They are fully drawn but too complex for safe manual stereochemical SMILES transcription in this pass, so labels/evidence are retained and structure_verified remains false.

regions.region: page 3 Figure 1b–e ECD and UV/Vis plots/caption
regions.finding: Recorded four technique-specific solvent-comparison series for (P)-1 and (P)-2. The caption's 10 μM value is preserved alongside the conflicting page-2 10 mM prose for (P)-1 UV/Vis.

regions.region: page 3 Figure 1f–g emission/CIE and lower-left emission prose
regions.finding: Recorded one (P)-2 CHCl3/MCH emission experiment with 365 nm excitation, 484/543 nm maxima, quantum yields 0.02/0.28, 15-fold increase, and the associated CIE color shift.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right mirror-enantiomer and IR discussion
regions.finding: Retained separate qualitative ECD records for (M)-1/(M)-2 because the main text explicitly reports opposite band signs, while numerical SI spectra remain unavailable. Began the (P)-1 IR record with its CHCl3 bands.

unresolved: Numerical (M)-enantiomer spectra are only in unassociated SI.
Spectral instrument settings, temperature, replicate counts, and uncertainties are not printed.

regions.region: page 4 Figure 2 structures and IR spectra
regions.finding: Recorded separate 1 mM CHCl3/MCH IR comparisons for (P)-1 and (P)-2 with every printed C=O/NH band and the intramolecular-pseudocycle versus extended four-fold H-bond interpretation.

Recorded distinct (P)-1 and (P)-2 VT-1H NMR experiments in CDCl3 with the reported qualitative amide-proton deshielding and unchanged other signals. Temperature points and numerical shifts were not inferred from unassociated SI Figures S4/S5.

Recorded one joint three-concentration (P)-1 VT-ECD series with 0.1 K min^-1 monitoring at 323 nm, Te=334/336/338 K, thermodynamic parameters, sigma=3.42×10^-2, cooperative curve shape, and negligible hysteresis. The 8.20 μM text/table value remains distinct from the page-5 8.16 μM plot legend.

unresolved: VT-NMR concentrations/temperature points are unavailable on pages 1–6.
VT-ECD scan endpoints and fit uncertainties are not printed.
Lowest VT-ECD concentration conflicts with Figure 3a legend.

regions.finding: Linked the plots to the existing (P)-1 VT-ECD series. The original image legend prints 8.16 μM while page-4 prose/Table 1 print 8.20 μM; both are retained as unresolved source values.

Recorded the (P)-2 solvent-denaturation series at text/figure concentrations 37/28/20 μM with gradual CHCl3-monomer addition to MCH aggregate, preserving the page-6 Table 2 mM conflict and fitted cooperative behavior.
Recorded the distinct failed full-disassembly observation at 363 K and the resulting inability to apply the one-component model. SI-only numerical curves were not imported.
